claims.text: Underspecified frames lead to incorrect interpretations, as seen in examples where the relationships between objects are not clearly defined.
Complex underlying physics not modeled by the system can result in mistakes, such as misjudging the force required to stop a vehicle.
Metaphorical language can confuse the model, leading to incorrect associations between entities, as demonstrated in the example of 'contained'.
